text:
kari: onboarding sample-app (node) hit a weird embed batch issue. when the helper retries mid-batch we get a null in the response array and one vector duplicated. reproducible locally.
mike: can you paste the minimal request/response?
kari: POST /v1/embeddings body:{inputs:[x,y,z], batch:3} response: {data:[{embedding:[...512...]}, null, {embedding:[...512...]}] }
anya: sounds like positional mapping after retry. node helper maps by array index at resolution; if retry requeues items indexes shift. python maps by per-item token id. parity bug.
mike: quick mitigation: set EMBED_BATCH=1 or disable client retry in sampleapp.
ci-bot: note posted to onboarding docs: "If embeddings look wrong, set EMBED_BATCH=1 and disable retries."
anya: proposal: inject __rwd_item_id into each input, server echoes it back in response.data[*].item_id, client maps deterministically. add preserveItemIds flag default false for compatibility.
kari: opened GH: redwood/node#1500 with repro and suggested patch.
mike: will review PR and add unit/e2e that simulates intermittent 401 mid-batch. ci queued.
anya: also watch for envelope key variance (embedding vs embeddings). sampleapp should accept both for now and warn.
kari: thanks team, catching this in DX before customers hit it is huge :)
